title: Sailing Okanagan Winds of Change Experiences
specs: Sailing yacht 'Anam Cara' is a safe and stable 46’ Hunter 460
Scenic views of wineries and natural areas on Okanagan Lake
Participants must be at least 16 years old for lessons
Comfortable boarding a boat from a small tender and have balance/strength for moderate physical activity for lessons
Guests must be able to move about a sailboat, walk, balance and climb a few steps on a ladder into and on the sailboat for sailing tour
Space limited to six students for lessons
Up to eight guests on sailing yacht for sailing tour; private groups available
includes: All lessons, handouts, and Sail Canada Log Book and Certification
Paddleboards, Personal Floatation Devices (PFDs) and safety equipment, sparkling water, refrigerator or cooler space, bathrooms onboard
gap: Price for the sailing tour is not stated
blurb: Guests can take a two-day beginner sailing course to learn the basics and earn certifications. They also offer a four-hour sailing tour on a 46' sailing yacht with opportunities to swim and paddleboard. The experiences combine sailing skills with personal development and wisdom teachings.
extraNote: Cancellation fee charged if booking is cancelled 1 day or less before the event for sailing tour · Sailing is dependent on wind and weather conditions; reschedule or refund if unable to sail · Naramata Marina, 3165 4th St. (sound end), Naramata BC
